description: This file defines the 'DeviceGrain' class which extends Orleans' Grain class, implementing the IDeviceGrain interface. It manages device state, including retrieving serial number and setting the owner, using Orleans storage provider.

classes.name: DeviceGrain
classes.description: A grain class managing device state, providing methods to get serial number and set device owner.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the device stored in state.

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the device to a given customer grain and persists the updated state.
